# ERP Project Architecture

## Layers
- **Controllers** → Handle HTTP requests & responses only
- **Services** → Business logic (rules, validations, workflows)
- **Repositories** → Database access (CRUD)
- **Helpers** → Reusable utility functions
- **Domain (Optional)** → Entities, Value Objects, Domain Services (DDD)

## Folder Structure
app/
 ├── Domain/
 │    ├── Loan/
 │    │    ├── Entities/
 │    │    │    └── Loan.php           # Entity (represents loan object, rules inside)
 │    │    ├── ValueObjects/
 │    │    │    └── Money.php          # Value Object (immutable, no ID)
 │    │    ├── Repositories/
 │    │    │    └── LoanRepositoryInterface.php
 │    │    ├── Services/
 │    │    │    └── LoanDomainService.php   # Pure business rules
 │    │    ├── Commands/
 │    │    │    └── ApproveLoanCommand.php
 │    │    └── Events/
 │    │         └── LoanApproved.php
 │    │
 │    └── Customer/
 │         └── Customer.php            # Another entity example
 │
 ├── Application/
 │    ├── Services/
 │    │    └── LoanService.php         # Orchestrates domain logic + repos
 │    ├── Commands/
 │    │    └── ApproveLoanHandler.php  # Handles commands
 │    ├── Queries/
 │    │    └── LoanQueryHandler.php    # Handles read-side
 │    └── DTOs/
 │         └── LoanDTO.php             # Data Transfer Object
 │
 ├── Infrastructure/
 │    ├── Persistence/
 │    │    ├── Eloquent/
 │    │    │    └── LoanRepository.php # Implements LoanRepositoryInterface
 │    │    └── Migrations/
 │    │         └── create_loans_table.php
 │    ├── Notifications/
 │    │    └── LoanNotification.php
 │    └── Helpers/
 │         └── LoanHelper.php
 │
 ├── Interfaces/
 │    ├── Http/
 │    │    ├── Controllers/
 │    │    │    └── LoanController.php # API endpoints
 │    │    └── Requests/
 │    │         └── ApproveLoanRequest.php
 │    └── Cli/
 │         └── LoanCommand.php         # Artisan command
 │
 └── Providers/
      └── RepositoryServiceProvider.php # Bind interfaces to implementations

app/
 ├── Http/Controllers
 ├── Services
 ├── Repositories
 ├── Helpers
 └── Domain (optional if using DDD)

## Conventions
- Use Service for business logic, not in Controller
- Repositories must not contain business rules
- Always write comment skeleton before coding
- Use PHPDoc for every class & method
